subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Delivery Time Windows
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Delivery Time Windows.

hook.text: Delivery between 8 AM and 8 PM. You wait all day. A 2-hour window changes your entire experience.

buildup.text: Narrow delivery windows tell customers when to expect their package—reducing the need to wait all day.

discovery.text: Customers value predictability as much as speed. Knowing the time is sometimes better than getting it faster.

twist.text: Tighter windows constrain routing flexibility. Every van must follow a sequence, limiting optimization.

climax.text: Companies offering 2-hour windows see 30% higher customer satisfaction scores than all-day estimates.

punchline.text: Customers don't just want fast. They want predictable.

quiz.question: What do customers value as much as delivery speed?
